title: fss.event_counterfactual_request.v1
description: A bounded inline caller-declared numerical sensitivity request for one exact retained event revision. The native owner enforces at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes before parsing and after canonical normalization, exact calibration reconstruction, integer token spelling without decimal fractions or exponents, and semantic constraints that JSON Schema cannot express. No path, historical-decision replay, source-custody claim or effect authority is admitted.

without_domains.description: Simultaneous exact contributing declared failure-domain losses. Every selector must be present in domain_scores_ppm and the source event; source/sensor aliases and synthetic common-cause collisions are refused by the owner.

domain_scores_ppm.description: Exactly one explicit JSON integer score for every source event domain on Supports or Contradicts evidence edges. No missing, unused, ordinal or alias entries. The parser rejects numeric strings, decimal fractions and exponent notation even when a JSON Schema validator regards their values as integers. Noncontributing source edges remain unchanged in source_event.

fusion_policy.description: Canonical signed decimal alert,retain,reject milliban thresholds, each in [-100000,100000], with reject < retain <= alert. The owner verifies ordering. Fixed remaining policy: two independent supporting clusters, no urgent exception, zero wait and look penalty, no operator confirmation.

digest.description: Exact nonzero lowercase SHA-256 content identity.

domain.description: Nonempty control-free declaration identity, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes in the native parser. JSON Schema maxLength is a necessary character bound only and does not replace the stricter byte bound. Exact retained event membership is verified during computation.

llr_interval.description: Optional computed summary. The owner requires two lexical JSON integers exactly equal to its outward-rounded reconstruction from the bin counts.

generation.description: Caller-declared detector/mode/scene/pipeline calibration generation. The native projection accepts at most 184 UTF-8 bytes so '@' plus the 71-byte digest fits its 256-byte calibrated generation. Character maxLength is only a necessary upper bound.

bins.description: Bin lower edges start at zero, strictly ascend and cover 0..=1000000. Both positive and negative totals must be nonzero and their sum at most 1000000. Optional hi_ppm and likelihood bounds must reproduce exactly; the native owner verifies these cross-field constraints and the digest.

score_calibration.description: The native fss.score_calibration.v1 counts artifact. Counts-only input or the complete fss-evaluate projection is accepted. Every supplied derived summary is checked, never trusted. Calibration applicability to the event remains an explicit caller assumption.
